goal: RG-308: map children for traceguard and logic-argument; public names between components

components.summary: TraceGuard: trace models, handoffs and reports around inference, depth and the case library.
responsibilities: Handoffs export ranked hypotheses and signed evidence to LogicGuard.
Reports print timelines, hypotheses and depth from native results.
Command output shows analysis results and full JSON needs --output.
state: trace models, events, storyline hypotheses, ablations and trace case-library data
side_effects: Write explicitly requested trace models, logic bundles, iteration results and case-library files

components.summary: LogicGuard argument work: handoff imports, iterations and reports around evaluation and depth.
responsibilities: Handoff imports refresh copied provenance without changing author text.
Argument iterations decide on explicit candidates and never write models.
Reports and the gap ledger present native argument results.
state: argument models, confidence and explicit evidence provenance
side_effects: Write argument reports and explicit candidate artifacts only through member commands

components.summary: Trace model schema, loading, validation and shared trace facts.
responsibilities: TraceGuard loads and validates trace models of events and storylines.
Results carry diagnostics and resolved entities for every route.

components.summary: Trace inference: solved storyline support and hypothesis projections.
responsibilities: Storyline support is solved from evidence first.
Causal support stays bounded below storyline support.
Undeclared evidence types stay neutral across every factor.
Projections rank hypotheses by support and mark live alternatives.

components.summary: Trace evaluation entry, storyline depth checks and predict-observe-revise iterations.
responsibilities: Evaluation runs inference and, on request, the storyline depth checks.
Depth checks perturb the model and judge expected sensitivities.
One expected-sensitivity check judges trace depth and question ablations.
Depth checks that causal declarations and oppose links never raise support.
Iterations compare frozen predictions with later observations.
Candidates keep observed rows and count only resolved gaps as progress.
The case library stores gaps and contradictions without solver histories.

components.summary: Argument evaluation, wording licenses, provenance, the model and its loading.
responsibilities: Argument evaluation weighs support and attacks within the block hierarchy.
Wording licenses come from deletion-minimal support and attack sets.
Evidence provenance is validated against the source model and library.
Default perturbations simulate the argument without changing the model.

components.summary: Native argument depth analysis, diagnostics and importance.
responsibilities: Native depth analysis covers every argument node within the budget.
Diagnostics explain blockers without changing the argument.
Importance ranks nodes by their effect on the root claim.

components.summary: Own the researchguard console and the four member command lines; dispatch each member command directly to its owner.
responsibilities: Dispatch researchguard logic|source|trace|experiment straight to the member main; unknown commands return one typed JSON error.

Own member command lines, including stable source stop rules, trace iteration direction and report/gaps/compare research-state views while retaining complete JSON output. Expose plain results with model freshness and no result identities. Require the viewer extra and tkinter only for the desktop viewer; reject the retired projectradar simulation mode.
Pass the already-loaded trace model into logic handoff export so the native CLI carries actual evidence content and polarity.
Expose score-actions from the same complete native plan scoring path as plan --all-scores, without a candidate limit.
Compare versions of one source model using actual gap semantic fields and nested qualification decision; self-comparison reports no change and retired gap.status stays rejected.
Create complete synthetic source and trace starter models whose sample data and evidence boundaries stay explicit.

Expose canonical --source-id intake/import and --source-model provenance checking; retire the unconsumed SourceGuard LogicGuard export. Dispatch status to the read-only research tree view while retaining member help and version formats. Expose --into on source-to-trace and trace-to-logic handoffs, requiring a distinct output file.
side_effects: member commands perform their existing explicit file writes

components.summary: One research question: cross-route identities, copy drift, ablations, candidate comparison and one verdict for writers.
responsibilities: Load the research index and resolve source-library provenance through the native validator.
Detect copied-content drift and direct evidence or conclusion disagreements between native routes.
Apply declared anchor ablations in memory and expose uncaught known-bad cases.
Project the authoritative search stop and root wording license into one five-key verdict; compare current and candidate questions without writing models.
The question model lists live hypotheses and contested routes from route states.
Ablation rows name side effects on other hypotheses.
Open gaps and next searches name the hypotheses they would move.
Evidence rows carry each route's direct direction per hypothesis.
One hypothesis reads back with its rows from the full status.
The candidate view lists every changed verdict key, ablation and disagreement.
state: loaded research index, native models and optional source library
side_effects: Read indexed model/library files and write only an explicit status --output

components.summary: Personal source library, per-source argument models and optional desktop browsing.
responsibilities: Import and deduplicate source material, maintain per-source models and project reading lists.
Browse and export the personal source library without requiring the optional viewer for core commands.
state: source-library files, project reading lists and node search indexes
side_effects: Create or replace explicitly requested library content, indexes, packages and viewer exports

components.summary: Arguments inside written artifacts and an argument-ordered unit plan for writing tools.
responsibilities: Audit structured artifacts and citation coverage against native argument models.
Produce the stable synthesis-request.v1 and synthesis-plan.v1 bridge; writing tools own outlines and delivery.
state: structured artifacts, citation mappings and synthesis requests
side_effects: Write only explicitly requested structure, citation and synthesis reports

flows.summary: Compare a frozen trace prediction with a later observation and choose the terminal reason.
License wording from native support and attacks.

Use neutral undeclared evidence types and model-authored finite strength tables consistently across every factor; preserve case model declarations.
responsibility:Keep command output to analysis results; full JSON is written only with --output.
responsibility:Solve storyline support from evidence first; bound causal support below it. Depth checks that neither causal declarations nor oppose links raise support; evaluate does not run depth.
responsibility:Freeze with an existing target and coverage; permit future expected evidence/event ids. Append typed observation rows in memory and compare canonical target support direction.

responsibility:Preserve newly observed rows in candidates; acceptance is independent of native depth closure. Keep prediction mismatches separate from native gaps, use the suite lineage helper and count only resolved native gaps as progress.
responsibility:Export hypothesis ids, native rank/support and signed evidence with original text/source/locator alongside the preserved v1 trace claims.
responsibility:One expected-sensitivity check judges trace depth and question ablations.
responsibility:Evaluate bounded argument support and attacks, preserve block hierarchy and report deletion-minimal wording licenses.
responsibility:Validate content-bound evidence provenance using the canonical source and library resolver.
responsibility:Refresh copied handoff provenance without changing author text, edges or unrelated records; iterate on explicit candidates.

accepted_debts.reason: SourceGuard has one job, the source belief state; its planner, scoring, depth and field definitions read the same schema.
Most of the size is the optional desktop viewer (viewer extra); the library core is source_library.py and its IO.
Optional desktop viewer: one tkinter window class whose drawing and event handlers share window state.
One SourceLibrary class owns imports, per-source models, projects and the index over one directory layout.
All SourceGuard fields are defined in one file so they can be checked against the field table.
All TraceGuard model fields are defined in one file so they can be checked against the field table.
One storyline depth check: perturbation plan, effects, expected sensitivities and closure read the same snapshots.
One native depth analysis: coverage universe, perturbations and closure share one evaluation.
The LogicModel dataclasses and their edge index form one argument model type.
The LogicGuard command line: one argparse tree whose subcommands only dispatch to member functions.
